svg.text: ELEGOO ESP32 DevKit V1 (30-pin, USB-C) · 830-Point Breadboard · USB Port Facing Up
NOTE: If your first pin (3V3) is at row 2 instead of row 3, shift all row numbers down by 1
Accessible: col a + col i (or col b + col j)
bridge rails across top (optional if using both sides)
Step 1: Power rails → Step 2: OLED display → Step 3: Servo motor → Step 4: Light sensor
